readings.title: Bless YeHoVaH, O My Being
readings.subtitle: A Call to Remember His Manifold Benefits
readings.text: [Psalm 103:1] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O <dn>my</dn> being, And all that is within me, Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name! [2] Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O <dn>my</dn> being, And do not forget all <dn>His</dn> dealings, [3] Who forgives all your crookednesses, Who heals all your diseases, [4] Who redeems your life from destruction, Who crowns you with loving-commitment and compassion, [5] Who satisfies your desire with the good, Your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

readings.title: The Compassionate Character of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: He Remembers That We Are Dust
readings.text: [Psalm 103:6] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is doing righteousness And right-ruling for all the oppressed. [7] <dn>He</dn> made known <dn>His</dn> ways to Mosheh, <dn>His</dn> acts to the children of Yisra’ěl. [8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is compassionate and showing favour, Patient, and great in loving-commitment. [9] <dn>He</dn> does not always strive, nor maintain it forever. [10] <dn>He</dn> has not done to us according to our sins, Nor rewarded us according to our crookednesses. [11] For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment toward those who fear <dn>Him</dn>; [12] As far as east is from west, So far has <dn>He</dn> removed our transgressions from us. [13] As a father has compassion for his children, So <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has compassion for those who fear <dn>Him</dn>. [14] For <dn>He</dn> knows how we are made; <dn>He</dn> remembers that we are dust.

readings.title: Everlasting Love for Those Who Fear Him
readings.subtitle: A Universal Call to Bless YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Psalm 103:15] A man’s days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes. [16] For the wind blows over it, and it is no more, And its place no longer remembers it. [17] But the loving-commitment of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> Is from everlasting to everlasting Upon those who fear <dn>Him</dn>, And <dn>His</dn> righteousness to children’s children, [18] To those who guard <dn>His</dn> covenant, And to those who remember <dn>His</dn> orders to do them. [19] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has established <dn>His</dn> throne in the heavens, And <dn>His</dn> reign shall rule over all. [20] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you <dn>His</dn> messengers, Mighty in power, who do <dn>His</dn> Word, Listening to the voice of <dn>His</dn> Word. [21] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all you <dn>His</dn> hosts, You <dn>His</dn> servants, who do <dn>His</dn> pleasure. [22] Bless <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, all <dn>His</dn> works, In all places of <dn>His</dn> rule. Bless <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, O <dn>my</dn> being!

readings.subsection: A Song, a Psalm of David
readings.title: A Steadfast Heart of Praise
readings.subtitle: A Plea for Deliverance from on High
readings.text: [Psalm 108:1] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>my</dn> heart is steadfast; <dn>I</dn> sing and give praise – even <dn>my</dn> esteem. [2] Awake, harp and lyre! <dn>I</dn> awake the dawn. [3] <dn>I</dn> praise You, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, among peoples, And <dn>I</dn> sing praises to You among the nations. [4] For Your loving-commitment is great above the heavens, And Your truth reaches to the clouds. [5] Exalt Yourself above the heavens, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, And Your esteem above all the earth; [6] In order that those You love Might be delivered. Save with Your right hand, And answer me.

readings.subsection: A Song, a Psalm of David
readings.title: Elohim's Promise of Victory
readings.subtitle: In Elohim We Do Mightily
readings.text: [Psalm 108:7] <dn>Elohim</dn> has spoken in <dn>His</dn> set-apartness, <dq><dn>I</dn> exult, <dn>I</dn> portion out Sheḵem, And <dn>I</dn> measure out the Valley of Sukkoth.</dq> [8] <dq>Gil‛aḏ is <dn>Mine</dn>, Menashsheh is <dn>Mine</dn>, And Ephrayim is <dn>My</dn> chief defence, Yehuḏah is <dn>My</dn> inscriber.</dq> [9] <dq>Mo’aḇ is <dn>My</dn> wash-pot, Over Eḏom <dn>I</dn> cast <dn>My</dn> shoe, Over Philistia <dn>I</dn> raise a shout.”</dq> [10] Who would bring me into the strong city? Who shall lead me to Eḏom? [11] Have You not rejected us, O <dn>Elohim</dn>? And You do not go out with our armies, O <dn>Elohim</dn>! [12] Give us help from distress, For the help of man is naught. [13] In <dn>Elohim</dn> we do mightily, For it is <dn>He</dn> who treads down our adversaries.

readings.title: A Cry Against False Accusers
readings.subtitle: They Repay Evil for Good
readings.text: [Psalm 109:1] Do not be silent, O <dn>Elohim</dn> of <dn>my</dn> praise! [2] For the mouth of the wrong And the mouth of the deceiver Have opened against me; They have spoken against me with a false tongue. [3] They have surrounded me with words of hatred, And they attack me without a cause. [4] In return for <dn>my</dn> love they accuse me, While <dn>I</dn> am in prayer. [5] And they repay me evil for good, And hatred for <dn>my</dn> love.

readings.title: Imprecation Against the Wicked
readings.subtitle: Let His Prayer Become Sin
readings.text: [Psalm 109:6] Appoint over him one who is wrong, And let an accuser stand at his right hand. [7] When he is judged, let him be found wrong, And let his prayer become sin. [8] Let his days be few, Let another take his office. [9] Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow. [10] And let his children always wander and beg, And seek food out of their ruins. [11] Let the creditor lay a snare for all that he has, And let strangers plunder his labour. [12] Let him have no one to extend loving-commitment, Nor any to show favour to his fatherless children. [13] Let his descendants be cut off, Their name be blotted out in the next generation. [14] Let the crookedness of his fathers Be remembered before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out. [15] Let them always be before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let <dn>Him</dn> cut off their remembrance from the earth;

readings.title: The Accuser's Just Reward
readings.subtitle: He Loved Cursing, So Let It Come to Him
readings.text: [Psalm 109:16] Because he did not remember to show loving-commitment, But persecuted the poor and needy man; And the broken-hearted, to put to death. [17] <dn>He</dn> also loved cursing, so let it come to him; And he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him. [18] And he put cursing on as with his garment, So let it enter his inward parts like water, Into his bones and like oil. [19] Let it be to him like a cloak he wraps around him, And as a girdle that he always girds on. [20] This is the reward of <dn>my</dn> accusers from <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And to those speaking evil against <dn>my</dn> being.

readings.title: Plea for Deliverance and Vow of Praise
readings.subtitle: He Stands at the Right Hand of the Poor
readings.text: [Psalm 109:21] But You, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Master, Deal with <dn>את</dn> me for Your Name’s sake; Because Your loving-commitment is good, deliver me. [22] For <dn>I</dn> am poor and needy, And <dn>my</dn> heart is pierced within me. [23] <dn>I</dn> have gone like a lengthening shadow, <dn>I</dn> have been driven away like a locust. [24] <dn>My</dn> knees are weak through fasting, And <dn>my</dn> flesh grows lean from fatness. [25] And <dn>I</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have become a reproach to them; They see me, they shake their heads. [26] Help me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>! Save me according to Your loving-commitment, [27] And let them know that this is Your hand. You, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, You have done it! [28] Let them curse, but You bless. They shall arise, but be ashamed, And let Your servant rejoice. [29] Let <dn>my</dn> accusers put on shame, And be wrapped in their own confusion as in a cloak. [30] <dn>I</dn> greatly thank <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with <dn>my</dn> mouth, And <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>Him</dn> in the midst of the throng. [31] For <dn>He</dn> stands at the right hand of the poor, To save from those judging his being.

readings.title: The Messiah: King and Priest
readings.subtitle: A Priest Forever According to the Order of Malkitseḏeq
readings.text: [Psalm 110:1] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to <dn>my</dn> Master, <dq>“Sit at <dn>My</dn> right hand, Until <dn>I</dn> make <dn>את</dn> Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”</dq> [2] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sends Your mighty sceptre out of Tsiyon. Rule in the midst of Your enemies! [3] Your people volunteer in the day of Your might, In the splendours of set-apartness! From the womb, from the morning, You have the dew of Your youth! [4] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has sworn and does not relent, <dq>“You are a priest forever According to the order of Malkitseḏeq.”</dq> [5] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at Your right hand Shall smite sovereigns in the day of <dn>His</dn> wrath. [6] <dn>He</dn> judges among the nations, <dn>He</dn> shall fill the nations with dead bodies, <dn>He</dn> shall crush the Head over the mighty earth! [7] <dn>He</dn> drinks of the stream by the wayside, Therefore <dn>He</dn> does lift up the head!

readings.title: Joy in the House of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Jerusalem, a City Bound Together
readings.text: [Psalm 122:1] <dn>I</dn> was glad when they said to me, “Let us go into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” [2] Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Yerushalayim! [3] Yerushalayim is built As a city that is bound together, [4] Where the tribes have come up, The tribes of Yah, A witness to Yisra’ěl, To give thanks to the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [5] For there the thrones of right-ruling were set, The thrones of the house of Daviḏ.

readings.title: Pray for the Peace of Jerusalem
readings.subtitle: For the Sake of the House of Our Elohim
readings.text: [Psalm 122:6] Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim, Let those who love You be at rest. [7] Peace be within your walls, Rest in your citadels. [8] For the sake of <dn>my</dn> brothers and companions, <dn>I</dn> say, “Peace be within you.” [9] For the sake of the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn> <dn>I</dn> seek your good.

readings.title: If It Had Not Been YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: Our Help Is in the Name of the Maker
readings.text: [Psalm 124:1] “If it had not been <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who was on our side,” Let Yisra’ěl now say; [2] “If it had not been <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> who was on our side, When men rose up against us, [3] “Then they would have swallowed us alive, In their burning rage against us; [4] “Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, The stream would have gone over our being; [5] “Then the proud waters Would have gone over our being.” [6] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Who did not give us as prey to their teeth. [7] Our being has escaped like a bird From the snare of the trappers; The snare was broken, and we have escaped. [8] Our help is in the Name of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, Maker of the heavens and earth.
